<function name="SortByColumns" parent="DListView" type="panelfunc">
	<description>
Sorts the list based on given columns.

All arguments are optional
	</description>
	<realm>Client and Menu</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="column1" type="number" default="nil"></arg>
		<arg name="descrending1" type="boolean" default="false"></arg>
		<arg name="column2" type="number" default="nil"></arg>
		<arg name="descrending2" type="boolean" default="false"></arg>
		<arg name="column3" type="number" default="nil"></arg>
		<arg name="descrending3" type="boolean" default="false"></arg>
		<arg name="column4" type="number" default="nil"></arg>
		<arg name="descrending4" type="boolean" default="false"></arg>
	</args>
</function>
